title: Implement a guarded Boolean caller for the rank-seven scalar layer
body:
## Summary

Close the scalar-caller part of PR3090's released handoff with one isolated research package. The common seven-fractional-bit, `P+20` capacity admits explicit reversible Boolean operations for all 9,992 ordinary prelude/A scalar macros in both pinned PR3076 providers and orientations.

```text
W=84, both real components          CNOTs       Toffolis     local bits
reversible target-walk control    17,163,992    6,593,136        335
direct scalar caller              6,806,482    6,426,884        251
saving                           10,357,510      166,252         84
```

The saving is 10,523,762 unweighted logical gates per provider word/orientation against the explicit control constructed here. Both implementations charge shifts, sign handling and clean return. The direct caller preserves sources and removes the coefficient scratch field; its 83-bit clean carry bank remains explicit. A uniform proof supplies the width-dependent tariffs for `3 <= P <= 128`. No optimality, physical runtime, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

[Proof, source pins, receipts, reproduction and open questions](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/b7a761ce2d6198509adb4b09ebf22b5b17ea2f55/research/rank7-boolean-scalar-caller). [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18984751).

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3090 certifies coefficient microstates but leaves bit execution and physical costs open. PR3080 supplies an ADD kernel; PR3081 supplies a local half-ADD caller.
  **After:** reached source/increment/output and SCALE-prefix guards bind every scalar occurrence to literal ADD/NEG/HALF/DOUBLE circuits. The comparison replaces scratch CLEAR with inverse preparation, charging complete local cleanup.
- Registered Python 3.12 cold replay passes in 45.11 seconds, with maximum RSS 212,533,248 bytes. It reconstructs both native words, matches the complete inherited capacity receipt, and evaluates 310 serialized small-width circuits over 225,334 exhaustive truth columns plus 1,250 independent bit-array fixtures.
- Fourteen behavioral groups reject wrong signs, omitted sign fill, missing carry/scratch cleanup, source writes, dirty stock, bad alignment and signed overflow. Correctness lint, formatting, source compilation, two internal read-only review rounds and all 43 committed-file byte comparisons pass. Hosted CI is separate.

```sh
TMPDIR="$RUN/tmp" uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -B \
  scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-boolean-scalar-caller
```

`RUN` is an external directory with a `tmp` subdirectory. Runtime needs only the standard library; all pinned sources and notices are included.

The result is conditional on exact adapter endpoints and intervening native non-scalar contracts. Adapter interiors, Boolean frame conversions/climbs/warps, recursive children, centres/later consumers, clean-stock production, routing, ownership and the complete supplier invoice remain open. Concurrent PR3091 implements separate Gaussian leaf/tape operations; PR3092 independently audits the reused capacity arithmetic. Neither is silently treated as admitted. Main remains pinned at `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority revision 6, at the submission checkpoint.

Credit Nick Petalas/PR3090/3089/3080/3081/3078, dcharb78/PR3042, Jeremy Kothe, Marius-Paul Dumitrean, Cinna Davis, DLamdata, eumemic, icekylinx, Tekalign and the retained native/geometry/owner lineage. Frozen source bytes and notices are unchanged.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

Only `research/rank7-boolean-scalar-caller/` and its opt-in replay are added. Shared code, canonical inputs, research priorities and the selected frontier are unchanged. Scientific supplier admission remains separate.
